external_test_firewall.prohibition: External test cohort scores, audio, metadata, and features MUST NOT be loaded, inspected, or processed during metric calibration or model selection.

primary_cluster_unit.name: piece_id
primary_cluster_unit.description: The musical piece is the mandatory unit of statistical independence. All segments, slices, transforms, and negative foils derived from a piece must belong strictly to the fold containing that piece. Segment counts must NEVER be treated as independent degrees of freedom.

sub_units.name: segment_4m
sub_units.description: Contiguous 4-measure window aligned to score measure boundaries.
sub_units.usage: Invariance, hard-negative discrimination, and baseline n-gram evaluation.

sub_units.name: segment_8m
sub_units.description: Contiguous 8-measure window aligned to score measure boundaries.
sub_units.usage: Closure contrast, surprise contrast, and formal boundary evaluation.

sub_units.name: section_window
sub_units.description: Formal structural section (Exposition, Development, Recapitulation, Theme, Variation) derived from ground-truth formal metadata or cadence boundaries.
sub_units.usage: Long-range memory reactivation and structural world model evaluation.

theme_identity_readiness.rationale: Canonical theme manifest data/annotations/theme_v1/manifest.yaml contains 0 accepted annotations. RC-008B pilot contains 20 candidate proposals but 0 human-accepted annotations.

baseline_models.description: Standard non-neural references against which representation and listener predictability are calibrated.

models.type: Unigram pitch-class and duration marginal distributions
First-order Markov transition matrix over pitch-class x duration tokens
Kneser-Ney smoothed 4-gram symbolic event language model

PERPLEXITY.formula: PPL(W) = exp(-1/N * sum_{i=1}^N log P(w_i | w_{<i}))
PERPLEXITY.unit: effective vocabulary size / perplexity per symbolic token

CLOSURE_CONTRAST.formula: ClosureContrast(S, P_cad, P_ctl) = [ListenerClosureScore(S o P_cad) - ListenerClosureScore(S)] - [ListenerClosureScore(S o P_ctl) - ListenerClosureScore(S)]
CLOSURE_CONTRAST.simplified_formula: ClosureContrast(S, P_cad, P_ctl) = ListenerClosureScore(S o P_cad) - ListenerClosureScore(S o P_ctl)
CLOSURE_CONTRAST.directional_hypothesis: ClosureContrast > 0 (cadential preparation increases listener closure relative to matched event-count control)

SURPRISE_CONTRAST.formula: SurpriseContrast(S, P_dis, P_ctl) = [ListenerSurpriseScore(S o P_dis) - ListenerSurpriseScore(S)] - [ListenerSurpriseScore(S o P_ctl) - ListenerSurpriseScore(S)]
SURPRISE_CONTRAST.simplified_formula: SurpriseContrast(S, P_dis, P_ctl) = ListenerSurpriseScore(S o P_dis) - ListenerSurpriseScore(S o P_ctl)
SURPRISE_CONTRAST.directional_hypothesis: SurpriseContrast > 0 (foreign harmonic disruption increases listener surprise relative to matched in-key control)

MEMORY_REACTIVATION_RATIO.formula: ReactivationRatio(S_reprise, S_prime, S_novel) = cos_sim(h(S_reprise), h(S_theme)) / cos_sim(h(S_novel), h(S_theme))

tier_1_symbolic_ngram.formula: L_max = max { |g| : g in Ngrams(G) cap Ngrams(Corpus_dev) }

tier_2_weighted_interval_ngram.formula: W_ngram(G) = sum_{g in Ngrams_k(G) cap Ngrams_k(Corpus)} w(g), where w(g) = -log2 P_corpus(g)
tier_2_weighted_interval_ngram.smoothing: Add-alpha (alpha=0.1) or Good-Turing smoothed n-gram language model estimated strictly on development corpus.

tier_3_latent_retrieval.formula: D_min(G, Corpus) = min_{S in Corpus} (1 - cos_sim(h(G), h(S)))
tier_3_latent_retrieval.description: Minimum latent cosine distance to any development training segment.

foil_types.description: Segment from the same piece but separated by at least 16 measures, matched for tempo, key signature, and register.
Segment from a different piece by the same composer with matching meter and primary key center.
Segment from a different development composer with matching genre (e.g. Prelude to Prelude) and density.

closure_label_provenance_hierarchy.description: Double barlines, fine barlines, end-of-piece barlines, repeat barlines.
Verified Roman numeral cadence analysis (PAC, IAC, HC) from annotated corpus files (e.g. Tchaikovsky/Chopin harmony annotations).
Movement or variation terminal measure indicators from catalog metadata.
Algorithmic root-position tonic arrival preceded by dominant harmony with fermata or rest; tagged as weak label.

threshold_selection_algorithm.description: For calibration of binary operational threshold tau (e.g. positive pair identity vs negative foil):
steps: 1. Partition the development pieces into 5 grouped folds such that all segments of any piece are in the same fold.
2. For each fold k in 1..5: compute the empirical ROC curve across pooled positive pairs and matched negative foils.
3. For threshold candidates tau in [-1.0, 1.0] with step 0.005: compute Youden's J_k(tau) = TPR_k(tau) - FPR_k(tau).
4. Let tau_k^* = argmax_{tau} J_k(tau). If multiple tau maximize J_k, select the one with higher similarity (tie-breaking toward specificity).
5. The prospectively selected threshold is tau^* = median(tau_1^*, ..., tau_5^*).
6. Uncertainty bounds for tau^* are computed via piece-clustered bootstrap across folds.

resampling_and_uncertainty_policy.confidence_interval_type: BCa (Bias-Corrected and Accelerated) or Percentile bootstrap
resampling_and_uncertainty_policy.clustering_rule: Cluster resampling strictly at piece_id level. Sampling with replacement draws pieces; all segments belonging to selected pieces are included in the bootstrap replicate.
